verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email delivery service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only describes Postmark as a hosted API service (managed dedicated IPs, server tokens, hosted endpoints) and documents no self-hostable or on-premises distribution of the core product. The official MCP repo mentioned in the community thread is an integration, not the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
